mapper.sql: desired_config_id, desired_capability, desired_model_name, desired_dimension, desired_fingerprint, serving_config_id, serving_capability, serving_model_name, serving_dimension, serving_fingerprint, serving_physical_index, target_config_id, target_capability, target_model_name, target_dimension, target_fingerprint, target_physical_index, deployment_status, task_id, start_revision, applied_revision, rebuild_migrated, rebuild_total, rebuild_phase, impact_image_assets, impact_ocr_available_assets, impact_ocr_empty_assets, impact_text_vector_failures, impact_visual_loss_assets, impact_report_ready, impact_confirmation_required, impact_confirmed, deployment_version, owner_token, lease_until, last_error, updated_at
mapper.select: select from embedding_profile_deployment where slot_id = 1 for share
mapper.insert: insert ignore into embedding_profile_deployment ( slot_id, desired_config_id, desired_capability, desired_model_name, desired_dimension, desired_fingerprint, serving_config_id, serving_capability, serving_model_name, serving_dimension, serving_fingerprint, serving_physical_index, deployment_status, deployment_version, updated_at ) values ( 1, #{desiredConfigId}, #{desiredCapability}, #{desiredModelName}, #{desiredDimension}, #{desiredFingerprint}, #{servingConfigId}, #{servingCapability}, #{servingModelName}, #{servingDimension}, #{servingFingerprint}, #{servingPhysicalIndex}, #{deploymentStatus}, #{deploymentVersion}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update embedding_profile_deployment set serving_config_id = #{servingConfigId}, serving_capability = #{servingCapability}, serving_model_name = #{servingModelName}, serving_dimension = #{servingDimension}, serving_fingerprint = #{servingFingerprint}, serving_physical_index = #{servingPhysicalIndex}, desired_config_id = coalesce(desired_config_id, #{servingConfigId}), desired_capability = coalesce(desired_capability, #{servingCapability}), desired_model_name = coalesce(desired_model_name, #{servingModelName}), desired_dimension = coalesce(desired_dimension, #{servingDimension}), desired_fingerprint = coalesce(desired_fingerprint, #{servingFingerprint}), deployment_status = case when desired_fingerprint is null or desired_fingerprint = #{servingFingerprint} then 'ACTIVE' else deployment_status end, updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and serving_fingerprint is null

update embedding_profile_deployment set desired_config_id = #{desiredConfigId}, desired_capability = #{desiredCapability}, desired_model_name = #{desiredModelName}, desired_dimension = #{desiredDimension}, desired_fingerprint = #{desiredFingerprint}, deployment_status = case when serving_fingerprint = #{desiredFingerprint} then 'ACTIVE' else 'DESIRED' end, task_id = null, target_config_id = null, target_capability = null, target_model_name = null, target_dimension = null, target_fingerprint = null, target_physical_index = null, rebuild_migrated = 0, rebuild_total = 0, rebuild_phase = null, impact_image_assets = 0, impact_ocr_available_assets = 0, impact_ocr_empty_assets = 0, impact_text_vector_failures = 0, impact_visual_loss_assets = 0, impact_report_ready = false, impact_confirmation_required = false, impact_confirmed = true, owner_token = null, lease_until = null, last_error = null, deployment_version = deployment_version + 1, updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and deployment_status not in ('BACKFILLING', 'VALIDATING', 'CUTTING_OVER')

update embedding_profile_deployment set impact_image_assets = #{imageAssets}, impact_ocr_available_assets = #{ocrAvailableAssets}, impact_ocr_empty_assets = #{ocrEmptyAssets}, impact_text_vector_failures = #{textVectorFailures}, impact_visual_loss_assets = #{visualLossAssets}, impact_report_ready = true, impact_confirmation_required = #{confirmationRequired}, impact_confirmed = #{confirmed}, updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and deployment_status = 'PREPARED'

update embedding_profile_deployment set target_config_id = desired_config_id, target_capability = desired_capability, target_model_name = desired_model_name, target_dimension = desired_dimension, target_fingerprint = desired_fingerprint, target_physical_index = null, impact_report_ready = false, deployment_status = 'PREPARED', task_id = #{taskId}, owner_token = null, lease_until = null, last_error = null, deployment_version = deployment_version + 1, updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and deployment_version = #{expectedVersion} and deployment_status in ('DESIRED', 'FAILED', 'ACTIVE') and desired_fingerprint is not null and (serving_fingerprint is null or serving_fingerprint <> desired_fingerprint)

update embedding_profile_deployment set deployment_status = 'BACKFILLING', owner_token = #{ownerToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, start_revision = #{startRevision}, applied_revision = #{startRevision}, rebuild_migrated = 0, rebuild_total = 0, rebuild_phase = 'PREPARING', impact_confirmed = true, target_physical_index = null, deployment_version = deployment_version + 1, updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and deployment_version = #{expectedVersion} and impact_report_ready = true and (deployment_status = 'PREPARED' or (deployment_status in ('BACKFILLING', 'VALIDATING') and lease_until < now(6)))

update embedding_profile_deployment set target_physical_index = #{targetPhysicalIndex}, applied_revision = greatest(applied_revision, #{appliedRevision}), lease_until = date_add(now(6), interval 5 minute), updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and deployment_status = 'BACKFILLING'

update embedding_profile_deployment set applied_revision = greatest(applied_revision, #{appliedRevision}), deployment_status = #{status}, lease_until = date_add(now(6), interval 5 minute), updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and deployment_status in ('BACKFILLING', 'VALIDATING')

update embedding_profile_deployment set rebuild_migrated = #{migrated}, rebuild_total = #{total}, rebuild_phase = #{phase}, lease_until = date_add(now(6), interval 5 minute), updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and deployment_status in ('BACKFILLING', 'VALIDATING')

update embedding_profile_deployment set deployment_status = 'CUTTING_OVER', applied_revision = greatest(applied_revision, #{appliedRevision}), lease_until = date_add(now(6), interval 5 minute), updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and deployment_status in ('BACKFILLING', 'VALIDATING')

update embedding_profile_deployment set serving_config_id = target_config_id, serving_capability = target_capability, serving_model_name = target_model_name, serving_dimension = target_dimension, serving_fingerprint = target_fingerprint, serving_physical_index = #{servingPhysicalIndex}, desired_config_id = target_config_id, desired_capability = target_capability, desired_model_name = target_model_name, desired_dimension = target_dimension, desired_fingerprint = target_fingerprint, deployment_status = 'ACTIVE', applied_revision = greatest(applied_revision, #{appliedRevision}), owner_token = null, lease_until = null, task_id = null, target_config_id = null, target_capability = null, target_model_name = null, target_dimension = null, target_fingerprint = null, target_physical_index = null, rebuild_phase = 'COMPLETED', last_error = null, deployment_version = deployment_version + 1, updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and owner_token = #{ownerToken} and deployment_status = 'CUTTING_OVER'

update embedding_profile_deployment set deployment_status = 'FAILED', owner_token = null, lease_until = null, rebuild_phase = 'FAILED', last_error = #{error}, deployment_version = deployment_version + 1, updated_at = now(6) where slot_id = 1 and task_id = #{taskId} and (owner_token = #{ownerToken} or owner_token is null) and deployment_status <> 'ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: delete from embedding_index_write_lease where expires_at <= now(6)
mapper.insert: insert into embedding_index_write_lease (lease_token, owner_id, expires_at, created_at) values (#{leaseToken}, #{ownerId}, #{expiresAt}, now(6))

mapper.insert: insert into physical_index_profile ( physical_index, config_id, profile_fingerprint, capability, model_name, vector_schema_version, dimension, max_applied_revision, lifecycle_status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{physicalIndex}, #{configId}, #{fingerprint}, #{capability}, #{modelName}, 1, #{dimension}, #{appliedRevision}, #{status}, now(6), now(6) ) on duplicate key update config_id = values(config_id), profile_fingerprint = values(profile_fingerprint), capability = values(capability), model_name = values(model_name), vector_schema_version = values(vector_schema_version), dimension = values(dimension), max_applied_revision = greatest(max_applied_revision, values(max_applied_revision)), lifecycle_status = values(lifecycle_status), updated_at = now(6)
mapper.update: update physical_index_profile set lifecycle_status = 'ROLLBACK', max_applied_revision = greatest(max_applied_revision, #{appliedRevision}), updated_at = now(6) where physical_index <> #{activePhysicalIndex} and lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select physical_index as physicalIndex, config_id as configId, profile_fingerprint as profileFingerprint, capability, model_name as modelName, vector_schema_version as vectorSchemaVersion, dimension, max_applied_revision as maxAppliedRevision, lifecycle_status as lifecycleStatus from physical_index_profile where physical_index = #{physicalIndex}
